observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show stacks of black console-style units, shape consistent with Sony PlayStation 4 (standard and slimmer Pro-style body) in a retail shop setting with phone boxes on shelves behind.
Faint PlayStation logo visible on the front unit's top panel in Photo 0.
Visible scuffs, light scratches and dust/smudge marks on the top surface of the front unit in both photos.
No controller, power cable, HDMI cable, or power/boot screen is visible in either photo.
Multiple units (at least 4-5) are stacked together, suggesting a shop display of several consoles rather than a single listing photo.
'McSteve' shop banner/bag visible in foreground, indicating a retail/reseller listing.

No controller is visible in either photo; only console units are shown.

proof_requests: Video of the exact console powering on to the home screen
Photo of the rear port panel and model/serial sticker on the unit being sold
